summary: Tested Pupu Discord bot status backend endpoint and React status page. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass. Endpoint /api/bot/status returns all required keys with correct types; bot online=true, 98 guilds, 28425 users, latency 46-47ms. Frontend: status page loads via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, status-pill shows 'Online', all four stat cards render real values, live-count shows '0 active' with empty-live visible, all three command groups (playback/queue/voice) present, page polls /api/bot/status every 5s (2 polls captured in 11s window), zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py bot_status endpoint: datetime.fromisoformat(doc.get('updated_at')) will TypeError if updated_at is None or not a string; the bare except swallows it but a targeted None-check would be cleaner.
App.js: on axios error, setStatus keeps prior status but never surfaces the error to the user; consider a soft error indicator.
seed_data_creation: None. Bot writes bot_status doc itself every 10s.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_bot_status.py covers schema, online status, guild count, latency, and _id exclusion. Playwright verified all data-testids: status-pill, stat-{servers,users,players,latency}-value, live-count, empty-live, cmd-group-{playback,queue,voice}. Discord command execution intentionally not tested (out of scope).
